definitions.explanation: A variety of peach with pale, cream-colored flesh and a delicate, sweet flavor. The most common type of {桃|もも} sold in Japan, prized for its softness and aroma; contrasts with {黄桃|おうとう} (yellow peach).

examples.japanese: {白桃|はくとう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べた→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{白桃|はくとう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧⟦{甘|あま}くて→甘い：00617_amai⟧ジューシーだ。
examples.english: These white peaches are very sweet and juicy.

examples.japanese: {岡山県|おかやまけん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{高品質|こうひんしつ}→高品質：18051_kouhinshitsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{白桃|はくとう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{産地|さんち}→産地：04031_sanchi⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧だ。
examples.english: Okayama Prefecture is famous as a producer of high-quality white peaches.

notes:
Compound of {白|はく} (white) + {桃|とう} (peach). Considered a premium summer fruit; high-end specimens are sold individually packed as gifts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {白桃|はくとう}⟦ジュース→ジュース：01033_juusu⟧: white peach juice
- {白桃|はくとう}⟦ゼリー→ゼリー：11025_zerii⟧: white peach jelly
- {岡山|おかやま}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{白桃|はくとう}: Okayama white peaches (the most famous region)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {黄桃|おうとう}: yellow peach — firmer flesh, often used for canning and baking
- ⟦{桃|もも}→桃：04382_momo⟧: peach — the general term; usually {白桃|はくとう} unless otherwise specified
